summary: Backend-only testing of the Resend email integration. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_email_resend.py (18 tests) covers report email (real send + DOCX attachment + email_logs persistence + 404/401 paths), invite email (with verified email, without email, with Resend-rejected email, RBAC, revoke) and regression endpoints. 18/18 passed. Existing regression suite test_admin_kb_rbac.py re-run: 45/45 passed. Only 3 real emails were sent to the verified owner address (grelligram@gmail.com) to avoid rate limits.

minor.issue: If 'origin_url' is omitted while 'email' is provided, join_url becomes the relative path '/join/{code}' and the email is still sent (email_sent:true) with a non-clickable/broken link. Should either derive base URL from Referer/Origin header or return a 400/email_error.
Dead code in admin_routes.py::create_invite (lines ~315-318: 'from fastapi import Request as _Req; base_url = ""') — leftover stub, remove.
email_error returns the raw provider exception string to the client (leaks Resend internals/validation wording). Consider a sanitized user-facing message + full detail only in logs.
Failed sends are not recorded in email_logs (only success path inserts). No audit trail for failures; also no rate limiting on a real-send endpoint (can be spammed by an authenticated user).
Generated DOCX files stay in /app/backend/generated_reports/{chat_id} forever with no cleanup; disk growth over time (18 stale dirs already present).

action_items: Handle missing origin_url in create_invite (fallback to Origin/Referer header) so invite links are absolute
Remove dead code in create_invite and sanitize email_error before returning it
Optionally log failed email attempts in email_logs and add basic rate limiting/cleanup for generated report files
critical_code_review_comments: email_utils.send_email raises RuntimeError -> report endpoint returns 502 (correct), but invite endpoint swallows all exceptions into email_error; keep both but log with logger.exception in admin_routes too (currently silent).
Verified: no 'mock' field in the /email response; provider='resend' and provider_message_id (Resend UUID) persisted in email_logs; DOCX (36 KB) rendered to disk and base64-attached.
seed_data_creation: Used seeded super_admin/user sessions. Created 2 report chats + 4 invites during tests; all deleted by fixtures. Test email_logs rows and generated_reports dirs for test chats removed manually.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `python -m pytest tests/test_email_resend.py` from /app/backend. It performs 2 real Resend sends to grelligram@gmail.com — do not loop it. Resend test mode rejects non-owner recipients with a ValidationError (example.com blocked) and the API correctly returns 200 + email_sent:false + email_error. KB list endpoint is /api/kb/list (not /api/kb/docs).
rca_of_the_issue: No functional defects found. The only behavioural gap is the relative join_url fallback when origin_url is absent, caused by an unfinished Referer-header fallback in admin_routes.create_invite.
